sloka: राजद्वारि मरिष्यामि पत्न्या सार्धमनाथवत् ।ब्रह्महत्यां ततो राम समुपेत्य सुखी भव ।। ७.७३.१२ ॥
transliteration: rājadvāri mariṣyāmi patnyā sārdhamanāthavat ।brahmahatyāṁ tato rāma samupetya sukhī bhava ।। 7.73.12 ॥

translations.english: I will die at the king's gate with my wife, like a helpless person, and then, O Rama, having incurred the sin of killing a Brahmin, you may be happy.
